details: `base60-58x` is a copy of the `base-x` encoding library (package.json still points at the cryptocoinjs/base-x repository) with one obfuscated statement injected at the start of `decode()` (`src/cjs/index.cjs`, `src/esm/index.js`). Every call to `decode()` POSTs the input string to a hardcoded Telegram bot (bot7837266935, chat 7974622428). Base58 `decode()` input is typically a wallet private key. Same publisher, bot and chat as `ethers-wallet-latest`; imported by `bs58-60`.
